scope: M1/M2 owned and coordinated initial audit findings
status: documents existing corrections; not a new audit or runtime verification

findings.resolution: validateRevisionPrefix checks normalized completed top-level forms, invocation paths, and arguments. M4 records old-to-new mappings and starts revised source afresh, using mapped receipts rather than decoding an old continuation under a new digest. Completed-prefix edits fail before dispatch.

GenerationRequest carries the closed ProviderControlsV1 object. Admitted defaults or explicit controls select effort, thinking, sampling, tool choice, and execution mode. Unknown keys and unsupported fields are rejected.

Association schemas require ordered unique keys. The verification schema supplies Boolean :passed and status, so the M2 conditional example can use native lookup. The standard example is implement-verify-review.pel.

Registry construction validates declarative descriptors and schema references. Descriptors include a resourceResolverId and envelope. M2 resolves abstract resources and M4 resolves concrete argument-dependent resources before effect admission.

Valid failure receipts yield PelStep.failed with PEL_HOST_FAILURE and unchanged HostEffectFailure. Pending siblings remain recorded and new release stops. Retry classifies a child failure before parent merge. M4 owns status and exit mappings.

M2 bootstraps the full canonical ProviderFailure union in providers/errors.ts. Its generation switch is exhaustive. Transport-emitted failures stop generation. M4 admits only canonical :rate-limited and :transport-disconnected transient retry categories. Host failure receipts preserve the typed cause.

Child IDs include the parent request and one-based retry attempt or race contender index, and prefix nested invocation paths. extractClosureEnvironment retrieves lexical data. All child counters, including abandoned losers, are charged once. Foreign-attempt receipts are rejected.

Snapshot roleBindings resolve ordinary role strings to exact profile, transport, controls, and credential references. Explicit :transport must be admitted. Ambiguous exact-profile transport selection fails. Role binding changes invalidate snapshotDigest.

The test:pel-authoring script uses the existing run-tests.ts wrapper with six quoted explicit test paths. It has no brace expansion and no unmatched checker.test.js target. Tasks require sh -c execution and the wrapper zero-match negative control.
M2 alone creates the minimal providers package, contract, errors, and TypeScript metadata. M3 extends it and depends on M1/M2. M2 catalog depends_on now uses the milestone identifier M1.
All provider subcommands extend M2 pel-authoring-cli.ts and pel-authoring-main.ts in the single dist/foreman.js bundle.

resumePel accepts receipt subsets. Suspend.ready contains all unreceipted released requests in stable invocation-path order with alreadyEmitted flags. A B-only receipt leaves A:true and no newly emitted request. M4 uses journal state rather than emission flags as dispatch evidence. The flagged-list alternative resolves the waiting-state ambiguity.

Case evaluates its scrutinee once and introduces a condition-local caret scope. Only literal string conditions invoke the predicate host function. Nonliteral string results are type errors. Tests cover explicit caret and once-only host scrutinees.

PDF verification corrects the KEY class to include * and < but not caret. ASCII |> is an explicit glyph normalization. Keyword precedence, malformed digit-leading numbers, lone minus, Infinity, bare greater-than, and standalone caret have explicit token/error behavior.

The installed path is runtime/assets/pel/default-authoring-snapshot.json. Dynamic collection bounds derive from schema maxItems, including the four-item fixture.

The bundle uses shared exit meanings: 0 success, 1 failed, 2 invalid, 3 needs-action, 4 cancelled, 5 pending. M2 input/source/environment errors are 2, exhausted or fatal generation is 1, and cancellation is 4.
